---
title: "simstim host idle"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set how long a created host may idle before it stops, for example 30m, or never

```text
simstim host idle <name> <duration|never> [flags]
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for idle
```
